shares_diluted.basis: ttm_shares_diluted = ytd_current (weighted average diluted shares for the current YTD period)

overrides_used.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-13), Note 14 Earnings per Share and Unit, 'Parent Company Earnings per Share' table (in thousands, except per share data): weighted average common shares outstanding for diluted EPS 182,234 in 2025 (183,040 in 2024; 176,371 in 2023); diluted EPS $2.82 / $2.11 / $2.04 on net income attributable to common shareholders of $513,810 / $386,738 / $359,500 thousand. EDGAR companyfacts carries no weighted-average share series for CIK 910606 after FY2020 (the filer tags share counts with dimensions the aggregated facts drop), so the engine fell back to point-in-time CommonStockSharesOutstanding counts (184,581,070 / 181,361,454 / 182,902,234).

ytd_current.note: share counts are weighted averages, not flows — used unprorated as the TTM denominator

overrides_used.source: Form 10-K for fiscal year ended December 31, 2025 (filed 2026-02-13), consolidated statements of cash flows and MD&A Summary of Cash Flow Activity: 'Real estate development and capital improvements' $435,112 thousand in 2025 and $343,368 thousand in 2024; the 2023 figure $232,855 thousand is the same line as tagged PaymentsToDevelopRealEstateAssets in EDGAR companyfacts (10-Q YTD facts of the same tag give Q1 2025 $101,386 thousand and Q1 2026 $105,071 thousand). Regency files no PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment or any other engine candidate capex tag in any year — its capital spending is tagged PaymentsToDevelopRealEstateAssets, which the engine does not read, so the engine has no filed capex value (last_filed_value null).
